name: plan_time_changes
description: Draft changes to Project Insight time entries and PTO for the user to review. Writes nothing to Project Insight: returns a draft (shown to the user as a review card where supported), or a clarification when a name is ambiguous. Each change is one of: create {date, hours, taskId or project + task names, description?, billable?, user?}, update {timeEntryId plus only the fields to change}, delete {timeEntryId}, create_pto {date, hours, timeCode name or timeCodeId, description?, user?}, update_pto {ptoEntryId plus only the fields to change}, delete_pto {ptoEntryId}. Prefer this over create_pto_entry/update_pto_entry/delete_pto_entry. PTO creates its own linked time entry; never add a time entry for PTO. After planning, summarize the draft and ask the user to confirm; only commit when they agree.

intent.description: One line saying what these changes are for, e.g. "Log Tuesday from H4T".

action.description: create, update or delete for time entries; create_pto, update_pto or delete_pto for PTO.

date.description: create: required. update: new date. Format yyyy-MM-dd.

hours.description: create: required. update: new hours. Use 0.25 increments.

taskId.description: Task id (GUID). Or give project and task names instead.

project.description: Project name, used with task when taskId is not known.

task.description: Task name within project, used when taskId is not known.

description.description: Work description. update: an empty string clears it.

billable.description: Whether the time is billable. create: defaults to false.

user.description: create/create_pto only: whose time (user id or name). Defaults to the signed-in user.

ptoEntryId.description: update_pto/delete_pto: the PTO entry id (not the time entry id it creates).

timeCode.description: PTO only: the time code name, such as PTO. An exact name wins, else a unique partial match. Or give timeCodeId.

timeCodeId.description: PTO only: the time code id. Use instead of timeCode when known.

name: commit_time_changes
description: Apply a draft from plan_time_changes or undo_time_changes to Project Insight, all or nothing. Only call this after the user has agreed to the draft. Refused if the affected days changed in Project Insight since the draft was made (draft again) or if the draft expired (24 hours). Includes PTO rows.

draftId.description: Draft id from plan_time_changes or undo_time_changes.

name: confirm_time_changes
description: Used by the review card's Confirm button. Agents use commit_time_changes instead.

confirmToken.description: The one-time token from the draft's result metadata.

name: cancel_time_changes
description: Cancel a time-change draft so it can't be committed. Nothing in Project Insight changes.

name: undo_time_changes
description: Draft the reverse of a committed draft (pass its id as receiptId). Returns a new draft that must be confirmed or committed like any other. Available for 24 hours after commit. Includes PTO rows.

receiptId.description: Id of the committed draft to reverse.

name: get_time_changes
description: Show a time-change draft or receipt by id, with its current status.
